newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OMV expects to improve on 1995 earnings.
newsitem.headline: OMV expects to improve on 1995 earnings.

text.p: Austrian oil and chemicals group OMV AG said on Tuesday it expected to improve on 1995's record earnings this year, thanks to a strong performance by exploration and production and cost-cutting measures.
"OMV expects the operating result for the full year to be higher than that for 1995," the firm said in a statement.
Last year OMV posted earnings before interest and tax (EBIT) of 2.19 billion schillings and a net profit of 1.73 billion.
OMV said it was looking at ways of further reducing personnel costs, particularly in its marketing and plastics sectors.
"It is anticipated that the profit situation in chemicals and plastics will remain relatively stable," the firm said.

It added that buoyant crude oil prices should contribute to a positive result in exploration and production. In the first nine months E&P posted a 60 million schillings EBIT, compared with a 300 million schillings loss in the year ago period. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
